name: @ops-automation/ai-passport-agent
description: AI Passport Voice Agent Terminal Firmware - A wearable, push-to-talk voice portal for ops-automation and AI agents

scripts.build: python scripts/build.py folo/ai-passport-c3 --name folo-ai-passport-c3 --language zh-CN --wake-word nihaoxiaozhi
scripts.flash: python -m esptool --chip esp32c3 --baud 460800 write_flash --flash_mode dio --flash_freq 80m --flash_size 8MB 0x0 build/merged-binary.bin

author: Ops Automation Team
